name: Pokes make Pixel curious, then cross
case: With an agent session open and nothing working, the person pokes Pixel once, then twice more a second apart. The first poke is welcome: a curious, happy, mischievous, amused or surprised face. By the third Pixel is annoyed, irritated or grumpy.
